title: eu-web-compliance project profile
description: Answers of the scoping step, stored in compliance/profile.json of the user's project. Every answer is an object {value, basis}: 'stated' when the user said it, 'inferred' when the agent read it in the repository, 'assumed' when nobody answered and the most protective reading was recorded. A missing answer and an 'assumed' answer both make the obligations that depend on it 'to-confirm'. The keyword x-protective-assumption states the protective reading of each answer; x-question gives the number of the question in references/scoping/questionnaire.md.

updated.description: Date of the last change to this profile, YYYY-MM-DD.

operator.description: Who operates the website (the person or body responsible for it, not the developer or the agency).

type.x-protective-assumption: None possible: the operator type decides which texts apply. Left missing, so the obligations that depend on it stay to-confirm.

activity_kind.description: commercial: the site sells, promotes or is funded by an economic activity. institutional: public body or non-profit acting outside any economic activity. personal: a private individual acting outside any professional activity.

headcount.x-protective-assumption: Not a microenterprise (no exemption relied on). No number is invented: the answer stays missing.
headcount.description: Number of persons employed by the operator.

annual_turnover_eur.x-protective-assumption: Not a microenterprise (no exemption relied on). No number is invented: the answer stays missing.
annual_turnover_eur.description: Annual turnover of the operator, in euros.

balance_sheet_total_eur.x-protective-assumption: Not a microenterprise (no exemption relied on). No number is invented: the answer stays missing.
balance_sheet_total_eur.description: Annual balance sheet total of the operator, in euros.

fr_turnover_3y_average_eur.x-protective-assumption: Unknown: the French Article 47 turnover test stays to-confirm for a company. No number is invented.
fr_turnover_3y_average_eur.description: Average of the turnover made in France over the last three financial years, in euros. Only used for the French Article 47 threshold.

country_of_establishment.x-protective-assumption: None possible. Left missing: national rules stay to-confirm.

regulated_sector.description: The operator carries out an activity that needs a licence or is supervised by a sector authority (for example banking, insurance, health, legal professions, gambling, telecommunications, transport).

target_countries.x-protective-assumption: None possible. Left missing: national rules stay to-confirm.
target_countries.description: Countries whose public the site addresses (language, currency, delivery, domain). ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, upper case.

sells_online.description: Orders or contracts can be concluded on the site, with businesses or consumers.

sells_to_consumers.description: The site offers goods, services or digital content to consumers (natural persons acting outside their trade or profession).

sells_what.x-protective-assumption: Unknown. Informative only: no condition reads it.

withdrawal_right_applies.description: At least one contract concluded on the site carries a right of withdrawal for the consumer. The exceptions to that right are not encoded in this skill: the user states the answer.

sectors.x-protective-assumption: Unknown: the European Accessibility Act rows stay to-confirm.
sectors.description: Services of Article 2(2) of Directive (EU) 2019/882 that the site provides to consumers. Empty list when none. 'e-commerce' whenever a consumer can conclude a contract on the site.

collects_personal_data.description: The site or a tool it loads processes data about identifiable persons (forms, accounts, orders, logs kept with IP addresses, analytics with identifiers).

special_categories.description: Data of Article 9 GDPR are processed.

non_essential_trackers.description: The site, or a third-party script it loads, stores or reads information on the visitor's device for a purpose other than the two exemptions of Article 5(3) of Directive 2002/58/EC.

third_party_tool_kinds.x-protective-assumption: Unknown: rows about analytics, session replay and email tracking stay to-confirm.

third_party_tools.x-protective-assumption: Unknown. Informative only: no condition reads it.
third_party_tools.description: Names of the third-party tools found or declared.

transfers_outside_eu.description: Personal data are sent to a recipient outside the European Union, directly or through a third-party tool.

conversational_assistant.description: Visitors interact directly with an AI system (chatbot, voice assistant, AI search answering in natural language).

content_generation_feature.description: The site offers a feature that generates text, image, audio or video for its users.

generated_content_published.description: The operator publishes on the site content generated or manipulated by AI.

emotion_or_biometric.description: Emotion recognition or biometric categorisation is used on visitors or users.

decisions_about_people.description: An AI system takes or prepares decisions about persons (for example recruitment, credit, access to a service or benefit, grading, pricing per person).

role.description: Role of the operator under Article 3 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 for the AI systems of the site. provider: it develops the system or has it developed and puts it into service under its own name. deployer: it uses under its authority a system supplied by someone else. both: one of each, or unsure between the two.

hosts_user_content.description: The site stores content supplied by its users at their request (comments, reviews, forum posts, listings, uploads, profiles).

languages.x-protective-assumption: Unknown. Informative only: no condition reads it.
languages.description: BCP 47 language tags of the site.

stack.x-protective-assumption: Unknown. Informative only: no condition reads it.
stack.description: Frameworks and hosting detected in the repository.

referents.description: People the operator can already turn to. Informative: used to address the 'consult a professional' lines.

note.description: Where the answer comes from: the user's words, the file that shows it, or why it was assumed.
